海军分项结合航空作战舰艇、舰载机、吨位、舰数、垂发单元和攻击潜艇。 这些指标分别: The naval component combines aviation-capable warships, carrier aircraft, tonnage, vessel numbers, vertical launch cells and attack submarines. These indicators cover maritime supply, aviation, air defence and underwater operations.
空军分项结合防空反导、卫星、军用飞机和运输机。 同时观察制空、国土防御、侦察通信: The air force component combines air and missile defence, satellites, military aircraft and transport aircraft. It considers air superiority, territorial defence, reconnaissance, communications and long-range deployment.
陆军分项结合坦克、火炮、兵员、人口、单兵开支与实战经验。 地面作战需要突击、持续: The army component combines tanks, artillery, military personnel, population, spending per service member and combat experience. Ground operations require assault capability, sustained firepower, personnel replacement and organisational support.
国防动员以人口、购买力平价GDP、国土面积及核力量等观察长期战争的兵员、生产、纵: Defence mobilisation uses population, GDP at purchasing power parity, land area and nuclear forces to assess the manpower, production, strategic depth and deterrence available for a prolonged war. These conditions affect the ability to sustain production, replace losses and absorb damage.
核弹头数量描述核力量规模；PDF明确点号后的部分记录战略导弹核潜艇数量。 战略导: The number of nuclear warheads describes the scale of nuclear forces. The PDF explicitly states that the part after the dot records nuclear-powered ballistic missile submarines, which support sustained deterrence and a second-strike capability. The report does not explain the marker meaning of some 0.1 records in the workbook; the digits after the dot must not be treated as a confirmed equipment inventory.
军费表示年度投入；单兵投入用于观察装备、训练和保障的投入强度。 总量与单位投入分: Military expenditure represents annual spending; spending per service member indicates the intensity of investment in equipment, training and support. Total and per-person spending offer different indications of scale and the resources available to support quality.
兵力字段在报告中指已经受训、可直接使用的现役常备人员。 报告采用现役人员，以减少: In the report, military personnel means trained, active-duty personnel available for immediate service. The report uses active-duty figures to reduce differences in how reserves are counted.
报告把航母、两栖攻击舰和舰载机共同用于观察海军航空能力。舰载机数量补充舰体数量所: The report considers aircraft carriers, amphibious assault ships and carrier aircraft together when assessing naval aviation. Aircraft numbers add information about aviation capacity beyond the number of hulls.
海军吨位表示平台总体规模，舰艇数量补充舰队覆盖信息。 较大平台通常能搭载更多装备: Naval tonnage describes the overall scale of platforms, while vessel numbers add information about fleet coverage. Larger platforms can generally carry more equipment, sensors, fuel and support facilities.
导弹垂发单元记录舰艇一次装填可承载的主要防空与打击导弹发射单元。 用于观察单个作: Vertical launch cells record the principal air-defence and strike missile launch cells that vessels can carry in one load. They indicate the air-defence, missile-defence and long-range strike capacity available in a single operational wave.
报告将点前部分解释为水下攻击力量，点后部分记录核动力艇。水下力量用于观察水下作战: The report describes the part before the dot as underwater attack forces, and the part after it as nuclear-powered submarines. Underwater forces are used to assess underwater combat capability.
防空反导结合研发、生产、部署和实战能力，观察国土及航空力量的防御条件。: Air and missile defence considers research, production, deployment and combat capability to assess the defensive conditions of the territory and air forces.
军用卫星提供侦察和通信信息；军民功能难分时，报告用民用卫星作补充观察。 卫星体系: Military satellites provide reconnaissance and communications. Where military and civilian functions are difficult to distinguish, the report considers civilian satellites as supplementary information. Satellite systems also indicate space and related industrial capabilities. The current column heading separates military and civilian satellites; the report does not provide deduplication rules or a complete classification of their functions.
军机数量在报告中覆盖战斗机、轰炸机和直升机，运输机另作观察。 军机规模与远距离投: The report counts fighters, bombers and helicopters as military aircraft and considers transport aircraft separately. Aircraft numbers and the ability to deploy over long distances and sustain operations describe different aspects. The precise overlap between military aircraft and transport aircraft is not fully specified; the two records must not be added to create a new aircraft total.
坦克用于观察地面突击力量，火炮范围包括火箭炮、榴弹炮和自行火炮。 少量代理指标分: Tanks indicate ground assault capability; artillery includes rocket artillery, howitzers and self-propelled artillery. A small set of proxy indicators covers assault and sustained firepower separately.
报告把近年持续参与实际战争作为实战经验的判断依据。 主要用于解释陆军组织、指挥和: The report uses sustained participation in actual wars in recent years as the basis for assessing combat experience. This mainly informs adjustments concerning army organisation, command and proficiency.
联盟关系用于观察情报、基地、补给和共同防御方面的外部支持。: Alliance relationships indicate external support in intelligence, bases, supplies and collective defence.
报告选取铁以观察钢铁生产方面的原料条件。 建筑、机械、车辆和军工的基础材料。: The report uses iron to assess the raw materials available for steel production. Steel is a basic material for construction, machinery, vehicles and military industry.
报告选取铜以观察电力电子设备方面的原料条件。 电网、电机和电子设备的基础用料。: The report uses copper to assess raw material availability for electrical and electronic equipment. Copper is a basic input for grids, motors and electronics.
铝用于轻量化结构，补充钢铁难以满足的轻质材料需求。: Aluminium is used in lightweight structures, meeting needs that steel cannot readily satisfy.
报告选取铬以观察不锈钢与特种合金方面的原料条件。 改善耐腐蚀等材料性能。: The report uses chromium to assess raw material availability for stainless steel and special alloys. Chromium improves properties such as corrosion resistance.
报告选取锰以观察炼钢与合金方面的原料条件。 钢材生产中常见的合金原料。: The report uses manganese to assess raw material availability for steelmaking and alloys. It is a common alloying input in steel production.
报告选取镍以观察不锈钢、电池和航空材料方面的原料条件。 连接工业材料与储能需要。: The report uses nickel to assess raw material availability for stainless steel, batteries and aerospace materials. It links industrial material needs with energy storage.
报告选取钛以观察航空航天材料方面的原料条件。 兼顾强度、重量和耐腐蚀性。: The report uses titanium to assess raw material availability for aerospace applications, where strength, weight and corrosion resistance all matter.
报告选取铅以观察启动电池与备用电源方面的原料条件。 部分基础工业和供电保障仍需要: The report uses lead to assess raw material availability for starter batteries and backup power. It remains relevant to parts of basic industry and power support.
报告选取锂以观察电池方面的原料条件。 支持电动交通和电网储能。: The report uses lithium to assess raw material availability for batteries, supporting electric transport and grid storage.
报告选取稀土以观察永磁体、电机及电子元件方面的原料条件。 用于高性能电机、传感器: The report uses rare earths to assess raw material availability for permanent magnets, motors and electronic components, including high-performance motors, sensors and some military equipment. The workbook abbreviates this heading as “tu”; the report discusses rare earths at the corresponding point in its mineral list, but the author has not yet confirmed the exact meaning of the abbreviation.
报告选取锌以观察表面保护与电镀方面的原料条件。 关系钢材及基础设施的使用寿命。: The report uses zinc to assess raw material availability for surface protection and plating, which affect the service life of steel and infrastructure.
报告选取金以观察工业与金融储备方面的原料条件。 兼具工业用途和危机支付属性。: The report uses gold to assess resources for industrial uses and financial reserves. It has both industrial applications and a role in payments during crises.
报告选取银以观察电子与光伏方面的原料条件。 良好导电性连接电子和光伏制造。: The report uses silver to assess raw material availability for electronics and photovoltaics. Its high electrical conductivity is relevant to both manufacturing sectors.
报告选取铀以观察核燃料方面的原料条件。 关系核电与长期燃料供应。: The report uses uranium to assess nuclear fuel resources, which matter for nuclear power and long-term fuel supply.
报告选取磷以观察磷肥方面的原料条件。 农业增产的主要肥料原料。: The report uses phosphorus to assess raw material availability for phosphate fertilisers, a major input for raising agricultural output.
报告选取钾以观察钾肥方面的原料条件。 主要作物养分之一，资源分布集中。: The report uses potassium to assess raw material availability for potash fertilisers. Potassium is a major crop nutrient, and its resources are geographically concentrated.
报告选取石膏以观察水泥和建筑材料方面的原料条件。 补充基础建筑原料覆盖。 本表表: The report uses gypsum to assess raw material availability for cement and building materials, broadening the coverage of basic construction inputs. The workbook abbreviates this heading as “shi”; the report discusses gypsum at the corresponding point in its mineral list, but the author has not yet confirmed the exact meaning of the abbreviation.
耕地面积与单位面积产量共同约束扩产空间，最大人均产量用于观察土地和技术提升后的潜: Arable area and yield per unit of land jointly constrain expansion. Maximum potential output per person indicates the scope for higher output through land and technology. Current supply and a potential upper limit are different and should be read separately. The crop mix, rotation and technology assumptions behind the maximum are not fully specified, so it is not a definite forecast.
谷物总产量、人均谷物与每日热量分别观察总供给、人均基础和实际热量情况。 规模充足: Total cereal production, cereal production per person and daily dietary energy describe total supply, per-person resources and calorie availability from different angles. Adequate aggregate supply does not automatically mean that everyone receives enough food. The existing explanation does not precisely establish whether daily dietary energy measures supply or actual intake.
肉类折粮按可替代谷物的热量进行折算，用于补充单看谷物的食物供给判断。 不同食物的: Meat is converted into the amount of cereal providing equivalent energy, supplementing an assessment based only on cereals. The energy contribution of different foods matters in comparisons. This is not the amount of feed used to produce meat; the conversion factor follows the Excel formula.
纤维作物、衣物、林地与人均木材补充食品以外的基本生物资源。 粮食数据无法单独描述: Fibre crops, clothing, forests and timber per person cover basic biological resources beyond food. Cereal data alone cannot describe textile and timber supply.
境内、流入和循环水，以及人均资源、取水与自给相关字段用于观察用水压力及对外部来水: Internal, incoming and circulating water, together with per-person resources, withdrawal and self-sufficiency fields, describe water pressure and dependence on external inflows. Water shortages can affect agricultural output and urban supply. The field names and conceptual descriptions do not establish every numerator and denominator; consult the original cell formulas. “Water self-sufficiency ratio” must not automatically be read as internal water divided by all water resources.
海水淡化可补充城市与工业用水，海水补充字段用于观察它对供给的贡献。 严重缺水地区: Desalination can supplement urban and industrial water supply. The desalination contribution field indicates its contribution to supply. Desalination capacity can affect the severity of shortages in water-scarce areas.
GDP描述年度名义经济规模，可用于观察跨境购买及支付所能调动的资源。 是年度产出: GDP describes annual nominal economic output and indicates the resources available for purchases and payments across borders. It is a common measure of annual output.
购买力平价GDP以本地价格差异调整生产规模，用于理解国内生产和动员基础。 国内人: GDP at purchasing power parity adjusts output for differences in local prices, helping describe domestic production and mobilisation capacity. Domestic labour and services should not all be valued in dollars at market exchange rates.
国内资产用于补充年度产出，观察已经形成的国内财富基础。 资产存量与年度流量描述不: Domestic assets supplement annual output by describing the wealth already accumulated within an economy. Asset stocks and annual flows capture different aspects. The report uses WID domestic wealth as conceptual background; the source, coverage and year of the current column still require field-specific evidence.
国民财富用于观察自然、人力、生产资本和对外资产等较广泛的存量条件。 补充单年GD: National wealth describes broad stocks of natural, human and produced capital and foreign assets. It captures long-term accumulation that a single year of GDP cannot. This is the broad wealth framework introduced in the report; it does not mean that every current value has been verified against the same edition of World Bank data.
资本存量用于观察机器、厂房和基础设施等已形成的生产条件。 与广义财富相比更接近现: Capital stock describes existing productive assets such as machinery, factories and infrastructure. It is more directly related to the capital used in production than broad measures of wealth. The report uses PWT as conceptual background; the database edition, year and price basis of the current column are not fully documented.
用电量为工业、居民和数字基础设施的运行规模提供一个实体活动线索。 它与价格和会计: Electricity consumption indicates the scale of physical activity in industry, households and digital infrastructure. It complements monetary measures because it follows a different basis from prices and accounting values.
较长时期增长用于减少单年波动，并观察经济能力变化方向。 长期扩张速度补充当前规模: Growth over a longer period reduces the influence of a single year and indicates the direction of economic capability. The pace of long-term expansion complements current size. Different growth fields may use compounded products or sums of growth rates; consult each formula. They must not all be interpreted as compound annual growth rates.
就业人口与总人口分别描述当前劳动力规模及长期市场和动员基础。 实际就业与人口潜力: Employment and total population describe the current workforce and the longer-term basis for markets and mobilisation, respectively. Actual employment must be distinguished from population potential.
0.几 表示曾经有航空母舰，点后部分在这类记录中是历史标记。: A record of the form 0.x means that the entity previously had aircraft carriers; in these records, the part after the dot is a historical marker.
点后 .1 表示有高级非核潜艇，是能力标记。: The suffix .1 means that the entity has advanced non-nuclear submarines. It is a capability marker.
0 表示有五代机，与防空反导评分无关。: 0 means that the entity has fifth-generation aircraft; it is unrelated to the air and missile defence score.
1 表示北约成员，0 表示其他美国盟友。: 1 means a NATO member; 0 means another US ally.
1 表示扣分项，-1 表示加分项。: 1 marks a negative adjustment; -1 marks a positive adjustment.
城市化率用于观察人口是否便于被教育、信息传播和现代资源组织体系覆盖。 人口过于分: Urbanisation indicates how readily education, information and modern systems for organising resources can reach the population. A highly dispersed population raises the cost of organisation and allocation.
政变暴乱字段观察政治暴力、政变、暴乱和恐怖主义等风险。 用于理解内部控制和冲突压: The coups and unrest field concerns risks such as political violence, coups, riots and terrorism. It helps describe pressures on internal control and conflict management. The direction and scaling of the original index are unspecified; a larger value does not automatically mean greater risk.
长期通胀用于观察财政金融协调压力，避免把一次价格冲击当作长期失控。 持续性通胀与: Long-term inflation indicates pressure on fiscal and financial coordination, avoiding the treatment of a one-off price shock as a lasting loss of control. Persistent inflation and a single year’s fluctuation have different meanings.
未来人口与人口增长字段用于观察劳动力、税基和动员基础的变化。 当前总人口不能描述: Future population and population growth indicate changes in the workforce, tax base and mobilisation potential. Current population alone does not capture future contraction. The report mentions a population projection for 2035, but the current columns are not all dated, so this year must not be applied to every population field.
劳动人口占比用于观察相同总人口下的可用劳动规模和抚养压力。 总量相同的实体，其劳: The labour population share indicates available labour and dependency pressures for a given total population. Entities with the same population can face different burdens on their workforce. The working-age population, labour force and employed population are not the same; the precise numerator must follow the original field definition.
天时观察外部安全环境；地利观察缺水、狭小国土等调整约束；人和观察人口质量对复杂组: Tianshi concerns the external security environment; dili concerns constraints such as water shortages and a small land area; renhe concerns how population quality supports complex organisation. These conditions describe pressures that measures of size alone cannot capture.
报告借人类发展指数观察人口健康与教育条件如何支撑科研、工业及组织能力。 受教育且: The report uses the Human Development Index to consider how health and education support research, industry and organisation. A healthy, educated population provides a foundation for sustained development. The report emphasises education and health, but the current field does not show a calculation excluding income; it must not be described as a recalculated education-and-health index.
科研投入用于观察经济资源持续转化为知识、工程和技术的强度。 当前总量之外，还需观: Research spending indicates the sustained conversion of economic resources into knowledge, engineering and technology. Alongside current size, it matters whether resources are invested in future capability. The report focuses on spending relative to economic size; the current column heading does not state a complete unit, so the website does not infer a percentage from that alone.
IMF投票份额体现一个实体在该国际金融制度中的正式权重。 提供一项可比较的制度参: The IMF voting share represents an entity’s formal weight within that international financial institution. It provides a comparable measure of institutional participation.
大使馆数量用于观察持续处理跨国事务的外交网络范围。 长期驻外机构可以支持国际事务: The number of embassies indicates the reach of the diplomatic network handling international affairs on an ongoing basis. Permanent overseas missions support the organisation of these activities.
工业竞争力用于同时观察制造业规模、技术结构和国际市场位置。 报告用CIP框架减少: Industrial competitiveness considers manufacturing scale, technological structure and international market position together. The report uses the CIP framework to reduce the risk of overstating small specialised economies based only on a high share of high-tech activity.
跨国公司字段观察企业组织跨境资本、生产和市场的能力。 国家的外部联系也通过企业网: The multinational companies field indicates firms’ ability to organise capital, production and markets across borders. Corporate networks are another channel for a country’s external connections.
外汇储备与主权基金用于观察外部金融缓冲和可配置资产。 反映危机支付、市场干预及海: Foreign exchange reserves and sovereign wealth funds indicate external financial buffers and assets available for allocation. They reflect conditions for crisis payments, market intervention and deploying resources overseas.
天然气、煤炭和石油产量描述当前可提供的一次能源。 可在短期冲击下直接使用的资源由: Natural gas, coal and oil production describe the primary energy currently available. Existing capacity and output determine the resources directly available during a short-term disruption.
能源储量用于补充当前产量，观察较长期的资源基础。 高产量可能伴随快速消耗，不能单: Energy reserves complement current output by describing the resource base over a longer horizon. High production may also mean rapid depletion; current output alone cannot establish long-term supply.
能源消耗描述本地需求，结合生产量理解自给和进口依赖。 本来不使用某能源的实体不宜: Energy consumption describes local demand. Read alongside production, it helps explain self-sufficiency and import dependence. An entity that does not use a particular fuel should not be interpreted in the same way as one that uses it but lacks supply.
自给率用于观察国内需求有多少能被本国产量覆盖。 产量与需求的关系比单纯资源总量更: Self-sufficiency ratios indicate how much domestic demand can be covered by domestic production. The relationship between production and demand describes shortages more directly than total resources alone.
储采年限以当前生产速度把储量转换成时间尺度。 将资源基础和现实开采速度联系起来。: A reserves-to-production ratio converts reserves into a time span at the current production rate. It connects the resource base with the actual pace of extraction. This is a ratio calculated at current production, not a date when resources will necessarily run out.
核电和风水光可减少发电环节对化石燃料的依赖。 为缺少油气煤的实体提供实际运行中的: Nuclear, wind, hydro and solar power can reduce dependence on fossil fuels in electricity generation. They provide operating sources of supplementary electricity for entities short of oil, gas or coal. The electricity mix differs from the mix of all energy consumption; the exact components of “Other share” are not fully specified.
交通密度使用作者估计的有效国土面积，扣除不需要充分覆盖的大片荒漠、冻原、极端高原: Transport densities use the author’s estimate of effective land area, excluding large deserts, tundra, extreme highlands and hard-to-access rainforests that do not require full coverage. This reduces the mechanical penalty that a large nominal area would otherwise impose on density. These figures are not automatically equivalent to official territorial area; the report does not detail each entity’s deductions.
道路长度和密度描述普遍的末端运输及人员流动覆盖。 道路承担连接居民和生产地点的基: Road length and density describe coverage for everyday local transport and the movement of people. Roads provide the basic links between residents and production sites.
铁路里程和密度用于观察大宗货物、长距离重载及跨区域运输骨架。 铁路对持续工业和动: Railway length and density describe the network for bulk freight, long-distance heavy transport and interregional movement. Rail plays a distinctive role in sustaining industry and mobilisation logistics.
机场数量和密度补充远距离快速连接条件。 快速投送与地面运输所描述的时间距离不同。: Airport numbers and density indicate conditions for fast, long-distance connections. Rapid deployment captures a different aspect of travel time and distance from surface transport.
汽车总量和人均汽车数量用于观察道路之外的运输载具基础。 拥有道路不代表已有足够车: Total motor vehicles and vehicles per person indicate the vehicle base available to use the road network. Having roads does not mean there are enough vehicles to carry the traffic.
内河航道和通航比用于观察低成本大宗水运条件。 可通航水道有助于降低国内货物流动成: Inland waterways and the navigation ratio indicate conditions for low-cost bulk water transport. Navigable waterways can reduce the cost of moving goods domestically. Read the navigation ratio with its original formula; it is not automatically the share of all river sections that are navigable.
网络分数和名次用于观察信息连接能力。 数字连接支持现代组织、服务及物流。: Network scores and ranks indicate information connectivity. Digital connections support modern organisation, services and logistics.
物流绩效观察海关、运输组织、追踪和时效等运行效率。 仅靠网络长度和密度无法描述运: Logistics performance considers operating efficiency, including customs, transport organisation, tracking and timeliness. Network length and density alone do not establish whether transport can be used efficiently.
综合名次保留作者在工作簿中的最终结果，包含统计、公式参考与人工判断。相邻名次差不: The overall rank preserves the author’s final workbook result, which combines statistics, formula references and judgment. Differences between adjacent ranks do not represent fixed multiples of capability; the website does not reorder entities by the formula reference value.
军事领域比较一个实体在自身地理和战略目标下发起、承受并长期维持全面战争的能力，分: The military domain compares an entity’s ability to initiate, withstand and sustain full-scale war in its own geographical setting and strategic context. It covers the navy, air force, army and defence mobilisation. Equipment, personnel and spending indicate scale, while geography, quality, supply and strategic objectives affect the final assessment.
长期战争能力，涉及海军、空军、陆军与动员，结论包含作者判断。: Capacity for prolonged warfare, covering the navy, air force, army and mobilisation; the result includes the author’s judgment.
矿产领域看工业原料是否齐备、国内需求能否满足，以及对进口的依赖和出口余量。 关键: The minerals domain considers the range of industrial raw materials available, whether domestic demand can be met, import dependence and export surpluses. Shortages of key inputs can constrain sustained production of steel, electricity, equipment, fertilisers and building materials. The report explains some major minerals; the current Excel workbook also retains more detailed fields.
工业原料的品类覆盖、供给、自给、进口依赖和出口余量。: The range and supply of industrial raw materials, self-sufficiency, import dependence and export surpluses.
农业领域关注粮食危机下的持续供给，包括土地与产量潜力、当前食物、水、衣物纤维和木: The agriculture domain concerns sustained supply during a food crisis: land and production potential, current food supply, water, clothing fibres and timber. Total output, per-person supply, calorie intake and scope for expansion describe different supply constraints.
粮食、水、纤维、木材等基础供给及危机韧性，兼顾现有产出和潜在产量。: Basic supplies such as food, water, fibres and timber, and resilience during crises; both current output and production potential are considered.
经济领域结合年度产出、已积累的资产与资本、用电规模、人口就业及增长，比较可持续调: The economy domain combines annual output, accumulated assets and capital, electricity consumption, population, employment and growth to compare productive capacity that can be sustained and mobilised. Flows and stocks complement one another, avoiding reliance on a single year of GDP to describe the existing productive base.
年度产出、资产及资本积累、实体系统运行规模、人口就业与增长。: Annual output, accumulated assets and capital, the scale of physical economic activity, population, employment and growth.
稳定领域关注一个国家或政权控制自身、组织人口资源并在长期压力下保持基本秩序的能力: The stability domain concerns a country’s or government’s ability to maintain control, organise people and resources, and preserve basic order under prolonged pressure. Urbanisation, internal conflict, long-term inflation, population structure and the external geographical environment jointly affect organisational costs and resilience. The PDF called this domain “Politics”; the website follows “Stability” in the current Excel workbook.
持续组织人口资源、控制自身和应对压力的条件。: Conditions for continuing to organise people and resources, maintain internal control and respond to pressure.
政治排名综合观察人口质量、科研、工业竞争力、外交网络及金融和企业联系，补充军事与: The politics ranking considers population quality, research, industrial competitiveness, diplomatic networks, and financial and corporate connections, adding aspects beyond military and economic scale. Knowledge, technology and external connections affect the conversion of resources into capability and the ability to act across borders. The PDF called this domain “Development”; the website follows “Politics” in the current Excel workbook.
人口质量、科研、工业竞争力、外交网络、金融与企业联系等影响能力。: Population quality, research, industrial competitiveness, diplomatic networks, and financial and corporate connections.
能源领域比较长期冲击下的能源供给，包括油、气、煤的生产、储量、消耗和自给，以及核: The energy domain compares supply under prolonged disruption, including oil, gas and coal production, reserves, consumption and self-sufficiency, supplemented by nuclear and renewable electricity. Current output describes available supply; reserves describe the longer-term resource base; consumption and alternative sources affect the extent of shortages.
油气煤的产量、储量、消费、自给率与储采年限，以及其他发电供给。: Oil, gas and coal production, reserves, consumption, self-sufficiency and reserves-to-production ratios, plus other electricity sources.
交通领域看人员、货物和信息能否有效连接，结合道路、铁路、机场、车辆、水道、网络和: The transport domain considers whether people, goods and information can be connected effectively, combining roads, railways, airports, vehicles, waterways, networks and logistics efficiency. Network length and density describe coverage; vehicles and logistics efficiency add information about actual operating capacity.
人员、货物和信息的连接与运输组织，涉及道路、铁路、航空、水道、载具、网络和物流。: Connections and transport organisation for people, goods and information, including roads, rail, aviation, waterways, vehicles, networks and logistics.
这份排名关注长期行动能力。生活质量、社会福利和文化价值不属于它的直接评价目标。: This ranking concerns the ability to act over the long term. Quality of life, social welfare and cultural value are not its direct evaluation objectives.
名次越小越靠前，基础条件评分越大越充分。不同领域不共用一套数值尺度，相邻名次差也: Lower ranks mean earlier positions; higher basic-condition scores mean more adequate conditions. Domains do not share a single numerical scale, and a gap between adjacent ranks does not represent a fixed difference in capability.
表内公式提供量化参考，最终名次还包含作者结合地理和战略环境的判断。网站保留原表结: Workbook formulas provide quantitative reference values. Final ranks also incorporate the author’s judgment about geography and strategic context. The website preserves the workbook’s results.
1分：明显短缺；2分：依赖外部条件；3分：够用；4分：基本完整且单项突出；5分：: 1: clear shortages; 2: dependence on external conditions; 3: sufficient; 4: broadly complete with a notable strength; 5: ample supply with a surplus.
不同指标的观察年份可能不同，未来人口属于预测。网站逐项年份仍以工作簿实际记录为准: Observation years may differ between fields, and future population is a projection. Field-specific years on the website follow what is actually recorded in the workbook.
看完名次，还应看能力结构。资源、运输方式、地理和协调条件会影响相同数量怎样转化为: After reading the ranks, examine the structure of capability. Resources, modes of transport, geography and coordination affect how the same quantities translate into sustained action.
保留综排中的作者既定排名；不以公式参考值重排。: Preserve the author’s established ranking in the overall sheet; do not reorder it by formula reference values.
数值、公式与缓存保持原表。单位来自表头或经核对的公式与量级分析，依据保存在uni: Values, formulas and cached results are preserved from the workbook. Units come from column headings or reviewed formula and scale analysis, with evidence stored in unitEvidence. Unconfirmed units, sources and years remain null. The public file removes only document identity and printer metadata.
有名称的领域数据字段（包含派生字段、名次和年序列，非独立指标数量）: Named domain data fields, including derived fields, ranks and annual series; not a count of independent indicators
领域数据字段（含未命名辅助项，不含实体名与领域结论）: Domain data fields, including unnamed auxiliary fields but excluding entity names and domain results
比较不同评价实体调动经济、军事、人口、资源与基础设施，并在长期压力下持续行动的能: A comparison of how different entities can mobilise economic, military, population, resource and infrastructure capacity and sustain action under prolonged pressure. The workbook’s results combine organised data, formula calculations and the author’s judgment.
最新版工作簿是所有实体值、排名及公式缓存的唯一权威来源。: The current workbook is the sole authoritative source for all entity values, ranks and cached formula results.
综排包含有既定排名的实体与尚未列入既定排名的补充实体；保留原名称与分类。: The overall sheet includes both entities with established ranks and supplementary entities not yet included in that ranking. Original names and categories are preserved.
政治、经济、军事在综排中为名次，数值越小名次越靠前；其余五领域为分级得分，数值越: Politics, economy and military values in the overall sheet are ranks: smaller numbers mean earlier positions. The other five domains use graded scores: larger numbers mean higher scores.
八领域结论和若干分项名次是工作簿录入值，并非都可由现有分项公式完整重建。: The eight domain results and some component ranks are entered values in the workbook; they cannot all be reconstructed in full from the available component formulas.
原表未命名的公式结果作为参考值展示；其结果可超过100，且不等同作者既定排名。: The unnamed formula result in the source sheet is displayed as a reference value. It can exceed 100 and is not equivalent to the author’s established ranking.
仅为展示而排序的指标顺序不构成新增研究结论。: Sorting a field for display does not create a new research finding.
研究侧重长期能力、供给条件与组织韧性，不是生活质量或福利水平榜单。: The research focuses on long-term capability, supply conditions and organisational resilience. It is not a ranking of quality of life or welfare.
梯队与领域结构比相邻名次的细小差距更适合解释。原始统计、派生公式、人工评估与既定: Tiers and the structure across domains are more useful for interpretation than small differences between adjacent ranks. Raw statistics, derived formulas, manual assessments and established ranks coexist.
当前工作簿的“政治排名”主要涉及人口质量、科研、工业、外交与金融联系；“稳定”涉: The current workbook’s “Politics ranking” mainly covers population quality, research, industry, diplomacy and financial connections. “Stability” covers internal organisation and conditions for withstanding prolonged pressure. Names follow the current Excel workbook.
报告第1、4页说明了标准化、初步加权和人工调整，但两份原材料没有提供足以完整复现: Pages 1 and 4 of the report describe standardisation, initial weighting and manual adjustments. However, the two source materials do not provide enough code and records to reproduce every research step in full. The website preserves the existing results.
综合公式的分母含最低分级项修正；欧盟该处另有减0.5的原表修正。网站逐实体保留实: The denominator of the overall formula includes an adjustment based on the lowest graded score. For the EU, the source formula additionally subtracts 0.5 at that point. The website preserves each entity’s actual formula instead of substituting one representative expression.
不同指标可能使用不同年份；文档修改时间不等于观测年份。: Different fields may use different years; the document modification date is not an observation year.
多数逐项来源、单位、年份及估算标记缺失；不从旧报告数字反向填补。: Many field-specific sources, units, years and estimate flags are missing. These are not inferred backwards from values in the old report.
空值与0分开保留，Excel错误显式呈现。: Missing values are kept separate from zero, and Excel errors are shown explicitly.
同名矿产字段和未命名辅助数据不擅自合并或改名为确定含义。: Mineral fields with the same name and unnamed auxiliary data are not merged or renamed to imply a definite meaning.
军事复合编码未作小数数值解释。: Military composite codes are not interpreted as decimal quantities.
报告第17页说明数据跨多个年份，不能据此为当前每个指标自动标注观测年。: Page 17 of the report explains that the data span multiple years. This does not establish an observation year for every current field.
有效国土、军事能力和若干资源分级含作者估算或判断；现有工作簿未提供统一的逐格估算: Effective land area, military capability and some resource grades include the author’s estimates or judgment. The workbook does not provide consistent cell-by-cell estimate flags.
数值、现有排名和公式的权威来源；未含独立来源表。: The authoritative source for values, existing ranks and formulas; it does not contain a separate source table.
IMF、World Bank、CIA、Wikipedia、Trading Eco: IMF, World Bank, CIA, Wikipedia, Trading Economics, Global Firepower, CSIS, FAO, EIA, World Mining Data, SIPRI, ITU, WID, UNIDO, Penn World Table, Flight International, ESA, USDA, UBS, TOP500, and national finance ministries, statistical agencies and foreign ministries. This is an overall reference list only; institutional homepages are not treated as evidence for individual fields.
原表无标题；缓存值可能大于100。不得用此值替换作者既定排名。: The source column has no heading, and cached values can exceed 100. Do not use this value to replace the author’s established ranking.
由储量与当前产量计算的比值，不是未来资源必然耗尽的年份。: A ratio calculated from reserves and current production, not a year in which resources will necessarily run out.
背景报告说明“肉类折粮”按替代谷物热量理解，不等同于肉类生产实际耗粮。: The background report defines “Meat in cereal equivalents” by the energy it substitutes for in cereals, not by the actual feed consumed in meat production.
背景报告说明交通密度使用的国土面积涉及有效国土的人工估算；不应直接解释为官方领土: The background report states that transport densities use a manually estimated effective land area. It should not be read directly as official territorial area. The current field does not document the estimation method for each entity.
带点复合编码，不是可加减比较的小数。原码保留，分项仅按点前与点后记录展示；不补未: A dot-separated composite code, not a decimal quantity for arithmetic or comparison. The original code is preserved, and its components are displayed as records before and after the dot. Unrecorded values and trailing zeros lost in numeric storage are not filled in. The whole code is not ranked or plotted as a quantity.
点前记录的第一项。: The first component, recorded before the dot.
当前可读码中点后的数字串；不补前后零，不宣称恢复数值存储已丢失的尾零。: The digit string after the dot in the current readable code. No leading or trailing zeros are added, and trailing zeros lost in numeric storage are not claimed to have been recovered.
两部分按复合编码读取，不作小数运算；点后码保留其记录状态，不能据此确认丢失的尾零: Read the two parts as a composite code, not as a decimal for calculation. The part after the dot retains its recorded status; it cannot establish any trailing zeros that were lost.
原可读码没有点后部分；第二项未记录，不自动补0。: The readable source code has no part after the dot. The second component was not recorded and is not automatically set to zero.
只记录第一项；没有分隔点不代表第二项为0。: Only the first component is recorded. The absence of a separator dot does not mean that the second component is zero.
原单元格未记录可读取的该项编码。: The source cell contains no readable code for this component.
原单元格为空；未记录不等于0。: The source cell is blank. An unrecorded value is not zero.
保留全部单元格、公式和缓存；仅清除作者及打印机元数据。: All cells, formulas and cached results are preserved. Only author and printer metadata have been removed.
按实体联结全部领域字段；空值、错误、复合码分开保留。: All domain fields joined by entity, with missing values, errors and composite codes kept distinct.
含字段定义、全部单元格、公式、缓存、原始文本及溯源坐标。: Includes field definitions, all cells, formulas, cached results, original text and source cell references.
原表顺序与全部辅助行；单元格值为原工作簿缓存，公式见JSON。: Preserves source order and all auxiliary rows. Cell values are the workbook’s cached results; formulas are available in the JSON file.
原码、可读码和两个分项的记录码与状态；不补未记录值或丢失尾零，不能作为完整军备清: Original and readable codes, plus the recorded codes and statuses of both components. Unrecorded values and lost trailing zeros are not filled in; this is not a complete equipment inventory.
两部分按复合编码读取，不作小数运算；点后码保留其记录状态，不能据此确认丢失的尾零: Read the two parts as a composite code, not as a decimal for calculation. The part after the dot retains its recorded status; it cannot establish any trailing zeros that were lost. Confirmed by the author (2026-09-25): Advanced non-nuclear submarines. This component is a marker.

Read the two parts as a composite code, not as a decimal for calculation. The part after the dot retains its recorded status; it cannot establish any trailing zeros that were lost. Confirmed by the author (2026-09-25): Previously had aircraft carriers. This component is a marker.
源工作簿包含 #DIV/0!，原样保留；不替换为0。: The source workbook contains #DIV/0! errors. They are preserved as recorded, not replaced with zero.
领域值超出常规展示范围，原值保留但不纳入相对位置图。: The domain value falls outside the usual display range. Its original value is preserved but excluded from the relative-position chart.
既定排名与公式参考值降序存在 15 处相邻逆序；展示既定排名，不自动重排。: There are 15 adjacent inversions between the established ranking and descending formula reference values. The established ranking is displayed without automatic reordering.
原表未命名公式参考值存在大于100的值，不能称作百分制。: Some unnamed formula reference values exceed 100 and must not be described as scores out of 100.
同名字段保留为不同列，不合并。: Fields with the same name remain separate columns and are not merged.
多数字段没有逐项来源、完整单位与年份；未标注的信息保持空值。: Many fields lack individual sources, complete units and years. Unspecified metadata remain empty.
12 个领域辅助字段没有原表头；另保留矿产表无实体辅助行。: 12 domain auxiliary fields have no original column heading. The minerals sheet also retains auxiliary rows without an entity.
缺失值没有统一说明；网站保留空白，不将空值推定为0或自动估算。: Missing values have no uniform explanation. The website preserves blanks rather than treating them as zero or estimating replacements.
五个军事字段为带点复合编码。原码保留，附15位有效数字的可读展示与点前/点后记录: Five military fields contain dot-separated composite codes. The original codes are preserved alongside readable versions using 15 significant digits and separate records before and after the dot. Lost trailing zeros are not restored, and whole codes are not ranked or plotted as continuous quantities.
能源“石油综合”存在不同公式写法，均按原式与原缓存展示；修改需由作者判断。: The energy field “Oil composite measure” uses different formula forms. Each is shown with its original formula and cached value; any change requires the author’s judgment.
农业“水源自给率”当前按年用水量/循环水计算；名称与计算含义应由作者核对。: The agriculture field “Water self-sufficiency ratio” currently divides annual water use by circulating water. The author should review the relationship between its name and calculation.
稳定“人口增长”公式包含乘10，时间与百分比口径未标注，不补推单位。: The stability field “Population growth” includes a multiplication by 10. Its time basis and percentage scale are unspecified, so no unit is inferred.
朝鲜军费原值为0；历史说明将其视作缺失占位，保留0且不解读为实际零军费。: North Korea’s recorded military expenditure is zero. A historical explanation identifies it as a placeholder for missing data. Zero is preserved without interpreting it as actual zero expenditure.
